    The emulator's settings and their defaults

    emulatorDefaults.Rd

    emulatorControl (a module parameter) overrides any of these by name.

    emulatorDefaults()

    Value

    a named list:

    • designPerParam (20): the space-filling design (maximin Latin hypercube, lhs::maximinLHS()) has this many points per parameter, each evaluated once;

    • designRepPoints (4), designReps (6): that many of the design points are evaluated designReps times more, so the GP sees the noise away from the optimum;

    • globalMaxEvals (1000), maxEvals (1600): the budget of real evaluations of the global phase, and of both phases together;

    • minEvals (600): no phase stops for lack of improvement before this many evaluations;

    • globalWindow (6), localWindow (5), relTol (0.002): a phase stops when the GP's best mean (at an evaluated point) improved by less than relTol times itself over its last globalWindow/localWindow batches (the prototype: 2 objective units at ~938);

    • batchSize (NULL): evaluations per batch; NULL is the cluster's number of workers, or 48 without one;

    • floorFrac (0.8), globalCapRatio (10), localCapRatio (1.18): the GP models log(min(y, cap) - floorFrac * min(y)), with cap globalCapRatio times the best value seen in the global phase and localCapRatio times the GP's best mean in the local phase, so failures (the objective's fail value, and runaway sets scored in the millions) sit on a plateau instead of dominating the fit;

    • nCandidates (4000), nPerturb (3000), perturbSD (c(0.005, 0.015, 0.04, 0.1)), nTop (20): each batch is chosen from nCandidates Latin-hypercube points (in the trust region in the local phase) and nPerturb Gaussian perturbations, at each perturbSD (unit-box scale), of the nTop best points by GP mean;

    • exclusion (0.25): batch members are at least this far apart in lengthscale units;

    • lcbSD (2): the exploration picks minimise the GP mean minus this many standard deviations;

    • trustTop (40): the local phase's trust region is the box around the trustTop best points by GP mean, widened by half its width each side;

    • boxWiden (1), boxMinWidthFrac (0.1): the search box is the range of the threshold calibration's passing sets widened by boxWiden times that range each side, at least boxMinWidthFrac of upper - lower wide, clipped to lower/upper;

    • thetaBounds (c(0.01, 5)), gpMaxit (200), gpThreads (6): the GP's lengthscale bounds (unit box), optimiser iterations (hetGP::mleHetGP()) and BLAS threads (the rest of the search runs on one).
